title: Flat Earth Evidence Hub — Classroom
tagline: A sequenced course that steelmans FE claims with sources, labels evidence honestly, and never calls flat Earth proven science.

modules.title: Foundations
modules.teacherIntro: Before we weigh any canal experiment or ice-wall claim, we learn how this classroom grades evidence. Three labels. No slogans. Named sources.

lessons.title: How to read claims
goals: Name the three evidence labels
Spot a slogan that skips heights or atmosphere
Know what ‘steelman’ means here

lessons.title: What this course is — and isn’t
goals: State the mission without hype
List what the site refuses to do
Find the methodology page

modules.title: Water & level
modules.teacherIntro: The Old Bedford River is FE’s classic field site. We steelman Rowbotham and modern recreations, then carry Wallace, refraction, and what a fair test would log.

lessons.title: Bedford Level & water-surface experiments
goals: State the FE steelman for canal sights
Name Wallace’s mid-marker method
Label refraction as established optics

modules.title: Horizon & ships
modules.teacherIntro: Zoom-back videos are everywhere. In this module we separate perspective, magnification, refraction, and geometric obstruction — then you run the numbers in the lab.

lessons.title: Horizon, perspective & ships hull-down
goals: Steelman the zoom-back claim
Distinguish perspective from curvature drop
Know what logged heights would settle

lessons.title: Lab: horizon calculator
goals: Run globe drop vs FE ‘no drop’ side by side
State the formula assumptions
Treat FE no-drop as hypothesis, globe geometry as established math

modules.title: Maps & Antarctica claims
modules.teacherIntro: AE maps and ice-wall stories need careful labels. Projection maths is established; reading the UN emblem or Treaty as a physical disc perimeter is hypothesis or speculation unless primary text supports it.

lessons.title: Azimuthal equidistant & Gleason-style maps
goals: Define AE as a sphere projection
Cite Gleason patent / UN emblem carefully
Name southern-route falsifiers as contested geography

lessons.title: Antarctica, ice-wall & travel claims
goals: Steelman the Treaty-as-perimeter narrative
Read Treaty text as established primary document
Separate tourism/logistics facts from motive-only speculation

modules.title: Space imagery
modules.teacherIntro: Blue Marble debates often blur composites, processing, and authenticity leaps. We keep Simmon’s pipeline documented and FE authenticity claims labelled.

lessons.title: Blue Marble & space imagery processing
goals: Distinguish composite processing from ‘fake planet’ leaps
Cite Robert Simmon / NASA visualization notes
Keep Apollo film claims separate when sources differ

modules.title: Capstone
modules.teacherIntro: You’ve walked the strongest FE themes with labels. Now practice the claim-tester, weigh FE vs globe without sneering, and decide your next honest step.

lessons.title: Practice: claim-tester lab
goals: Run the FE-trap checklist on a real claim
Score anecdote vs experiment vs media
Save results locally only

lessons.title: Weigh FE vs globe — next steps
goals: Summarize strongest FE arguments you met
Name established measurements that conflict
Leave with sources, not slogans
